extracted.summary: WhatsApp exchange between rep Sam Karimi and client Layla Haddad about a home search; she is buying with her husband Karim (who must approve), with a budget cap of 3.5M, needs at least 3 bedrooms, a pool, beach proximity, and covered parking for 2 cars, and a viewing was confirmed for March 14. Layla Haddad is searching for a ready-to-move-in property with covered parking for 2 cars and a home study; she also mentioned her lease renewal and end dates, and Sam promised to follow up with the developer about a payment plan. Ongoing WhatsApp conversation between Sam Karimi and Layla Haddad about property listings, during which Layla shared several home requirements (a study, a usable kitchen, a possible ground-floor room for Karim's mother, and a floor-height limit) along with some personal details about her work and family. Ongoing WhatsApp conversation between rep Sam Karimi and client Layla Haddad about property options; she flagged a past developer's late handover, asked for options in Arabian Ranches, and said she'd sign if the bank approves financing by end of month. Ongoing WhatsApp exchange with Layla Haddad about her property search; she said she'd sign if the bank approves financing by end of month, stated preferences for a quiet area and airport proximity, mentioned her sister Rania is also looking for a 1-bed near the Marina, and flagged that their current rent feels like a waste. Mostly casual back-and-forth between rep Sam Karimi and client Layla Haddad with property listings shared; Layla mentioned frustration with high rent, her daughter Noor starting KG2 in September, and her father helping with the down payment; she will get a bank valuation report and Sam will confirm landlord details by Wednesday. Ongoing WhatsApp exchange between rep Sam Karimi and client Layla Haddad about property viewings for her search; Sam promised to confirm with the landlord by Wednesday, and Layla raised concerns about two properties shown, flagged she's also talking to another agent, and relayed a gym requirement from Karim. Ongoing WhatsApp exchange between rep Sam Karimi and client Layla Haddad about property listings; Layla wants to close before 1 September 2026, her colleague separately expressed interest in a 2-bed, and Sam committed to introducing her to his mortgage broker. Ongoing WhatsApp exchange between Sam Karimi and Layla Haddad about a property search, mostly short acknowledgments and listing links, with a few substantive updates: a complaint about a viewed property, family background, and an updated requirement for a 4-bedroom home now that Karim's mother is moving in. Chat history with Layla Haddad about an ongoing property search: she updated the requirement from 3 to 4 bedrooms because Karim's mother is moving in with them, and later added a need for a small studio for Karim's mother as an investment. She also joked that a 5M budget was out of reach and mentioned wanting balcony safety for her pet Mishmish. Ongoing WhatsApp exchange between Sam Karimi and Layla Haddad with multiple property listings shared; Layla asked for a small studio investment for Karim's mother and noted she will be away for part of December. Ongoing WhatsApp exchange between Sam Karimi and Layla Haddad about a property search; Sam committed to check the pool depth with the developer, send service charge history, and book a second viewing for Karim, while Layla shared some family dates and said a decision might come by end of year. Routine WhatsApp exchange between Sam Karimi and Layla Haddad with mostly short acknowledgments; Layla mentioned Karim saying they'll probably decide by the end of the year, and a meeting was set for Thursday 12 November 2026 at 4pm at the office.
